_meta.source: SciSciNet-v2/OpenAlex self-computed IF + OpenAlex 2yr_mean_citedness + SCImago SJR
_meta.note: Metric order [if2,if5,citescore,openalex_2yr_mean_citedness,scimago_sjr]. The first three are self-computed (no doc-type filtering / self-citation exclusion), systematically lower than Clarivate JIF - not Journal Impact Factor(TM). Index 3 is OpenAlex's published 2-year mean citedness (current snapshot). Index 4 is SCImago SJR for the publication year (pre-1999 uses 1999).
_meta.attribution: SCImago SJR data: SCImago, (n.d.). SJR - SCImago Journal & Country Rank [Portal]. Retrieved from https://www.scimagojr.com - used non-commercially.
